items.text:
I thought I knew where my money goes. Then Grok Bot read 12 months of my bank statements and I had to sit down.

I didn't do anything fancy. I exported a year of statements and let Grok Bot go through them. 1,904 transactions. In the video you can see the statement tape flying by while it tags everything: food, transport, rent, fun, and the ones I really didn't want to see: duplicate, unused 4 months, price up 30%, fee.

The donut on the right builds up as it goes. $3,941 a month, 38% housing, 19% food, 14% fun. Nothing crazy there. The problem was hiding in the small stuff.

Look at the subscriptions wall. 12 tiles, each with the price and when I last used it. Then the stamps start landing:

Cinewave, last used 4 months ago: CANCEL
FitPulse, 6 months ago: CANCEL
PhotoPro, 7 months ago: CANCEL
LangBuddy, 5 months ago: CANCEL
MealKit+, 3 months ago, $59.99: CANCEL
GymCo charged twice, a literal duplicate: CANCEL

The stuff I actually use, the music app, cloud storage, VPN, notes, got a green KEEP. 7 cancelled, $172.95 a month back.

Then it went after the bills. It drafted emails to my internet provider, phone plan and car insurance, waited for replies and countered:

internet $79 → $55
phone $45 → $30
insurance $142 → $119

Total: $2,819 a year saved, and my projected spend for next year is down 17%.

My honest opinion:

Nobody overspends on purpose. We overspend through things we said yes to once and forgot. A free trial that turned paid. A gym that charged twice. A price that went up 22% and nobody noticed because it's on autopay. It's never one big mistake, it's thirty tiny leaks.

And this is the kind of job where an AI agent is actually useful in real life. Reading 1,904 transactions is boring. Calling your provider to negotiate is awkward. A bot doesn't get bored and doesn't feel awkward.

The part I liked most: it never cancelled anything on its own judgment alone. It looked at real usage. If I opened an app yesterday, it stayed. That's the difference between a smart audit and a bot that just cuts everything to make the number look big.

Comment "AUDIT" and I'll DM you how I set it up: how to export your statements, the rules it uses to flag subscriptions, and the email it sends to negotiate bills

And be honest in the replies: how many subscriptions are you paying for right now that you haven't opened this month? I had 7, and I would have sworn it was 2

Follow-up to my analysis of The @X Subscription, based on 40,618 @grok @bot usage records (Oct 13 – Nov 3, 2026).

Grok Bot (@spacexai):
• Premium: €30/mo → ~1.97B tokens/mo (€0.0158/1M)
• Super: €100/mo → ~7.35B tokens/mo (€0.0139/1M)

Both include a persistent cloud computer with browser, terminal and filesystem access. My shell reported 8 vCPU / 15 GiB RAM / 128 GB storage.

How does that compare with alternatives?

@OpenBot_, @mausbot_ and Rakazo by @elie2222 offer free self-hosted software, but models and hosting cost extra.

Model subscriptions:
@AnthropicAI / @claudeai
• Pro €20/mo / Max €100/mo
@OpenAI / @ChatGPT
• Plus €20/mo / Pro €100/mo

Estimated ~1–6B tokens/mo depending on plan and workload. Not guaranteed limits or necessarily compatible with third-party bots.

EU VPS hosting (incl. IPv4 & 21% CZ VAT):
@Hetzner_Online
• CX43: €23.82/mo, 8 vCPU / 16 GB / 160 GB NVMe, backups included
@OVHcloud
• VPS-4: from €24.15/mo, 8 vCPU / 24 GB / 200 GB NVMe, daily backups
@netcup
• VPS 2000 G12.5: €31.48/mo, 8 vCore / 16 GB / 256 GB SSD, snapshots included (no automated backups)

@boatdotdev (CPU/RAM/disk, USD/hour):
• Small: 2/4/51 GB — $0.018/h
• Default: 4/8/51 GB — $0.036/h
• Large: 8/16/111 GB — $0.072/h
• Xlarge: 16/32/251 GB — $0.20/h

8h/day vs. 24/7 monthly costs:
• Small: $20 / $20
• Default: $20 / $26
• Large: $20 / $53
• Xlarge: $100 / $146

$20/mo minimum ($100 for Xlarge). Stopped VMs free, snapshots extra. Excl. VAT.

Managed hosting:

@mausbot_ (CPU/RAM/storage, cloud PC hours/mo):
• Starter $15: 2/2/20 GB, 100h
• Pro $49: 4/4/100 GB, 300h
• Max $99: 8/8/100 GB, 800h

Always-on bot host, daily backups. Cloud PC hours are separate limits. AI model costs extra ($10/$20 Claude credits included in Pro/Max).

@OpenBot_ (EU managed):
• Starter €20: 12 GB, 1 user (sold out)
• Standard €50: 50 GB, 5 users, 2× speed
• Pro €100: 100 GB, 10 users, 4× speed

CPU/RAM unspecified. VAT and AI models extra.

Home PC?

Potentially cheaper, but electricity, hardware, maintenance and uptime matter. Fast symmetric fiber helps with remote work. My 75/25 Mbps VDSL2+ connection makes upload bandwidth a limitation.

Caveats:
• Super's 7.35B/month is extrapolated from 4.64 days.
• 93.6% of Super tokens are cached reads.
• Claude/ChatGPT estimates partly rely on @theo's https://t.co/ReMoDF1W9l and community data, not official allowances.
• Unauthorized third-party use of Claude subscriptions risks suspension.
• Grok, Grok Bot and Cursor share a weekly usage pool.
• Claude Duet and Meta Muse aren't available in the EU, OpenAI Dots have limited EU availability. Excluded from comparison.

This compares cost for my workload, not model quality or equivalent capabilities.

One last thing, @elonmusk:

Bundling Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor, a persistent cloud computer and full X Premium+ benefits into The @X Subscription was a smart move.

For my usage, the combined package is more compelling than token pricing alone.

What are other users actually getting from their subscriptions?

items.author: temnco
items.text:
I gave a talk at a Claude Community House titled "How to Make Claude Multiplayer with Notion"

I feel that AI made us 10x more productive individually... and worse together. 

We became meatbag APIs™

Meaning my agent writes something, I paste it to you, you paste it to yours, and so on and so forth. 

It’s cause every person's context lives in their own AI chat. Your agent can't see what mine knows. The fix is a shared context layer in Notion. 

Own the context in Notion, rent the compute from Claude, Grok Bot, your own harness etc.  

Core context layer includes tasks, docs, meetings, decisions, projects and skills. Once those live in one place, every teammate's agent reads the same context layer.  Begone copy-pasta-agent relay! 

Watch it below:

03:39 Context architecture
07:15 Demo: tasks, meetings, decisions
09:57 Descriptions, verification, archiving
12:41 Notion agents
13:44 Sharing skills with your team
17:50 Own the context, rent the compute

zh-CN.summary: 作者在 Claude Community House 的分享：每个人的上下文锁在各自 AI 聊天里，于是人成了在 Agent 之间复制粘贴的中转。他的做法是把任务、文档、会议、决策、项目和技能放进 Notion 作为共享上下文层，各成员的 Agent（Claude、Grok Bot 或自建框架）都读同一层。视频含架构讲解和任务、会议、决策演示。

en.summary: From the author's Claude Community House talk: each person's context lives in their own AI chat, so people end up copy-pasting between agents. Dia telah meminta bayaran balik daripada sokongan dan setakat ini hanya diberitahu akan dihubungi.

vi.title: Mức dùng chạm 100% trong hai ngày, rồi hối hận vì trả trước Ultra một năm
vi.summary: Tác giả nói mức dùng Grok Bot tăng đáng báo động trong hai ngày dù Codex, Claude và Gemini mới là bên làm việc thực sự. Khi chạm 100%, anh tưởng mình chọn sai gói và nâng từ Super ($100/tháng) lên Ultra ($200/tháng), trả trước một năm $2.000. Anh đã yêu cầu hỗ trợ hoàn tiền và mới chỉ nhận được trả lời rằng sẽ có người liên hệ.

fr.title: Quota à 100 % en deux jours, puis un an d'Ultra prépayé regretté
fr.summary: L'auteur raconte que son usage de Grok Bot a grimpé de façon alarmante en deux jours alors que Codex, Claude et Gemini faisaient le vrai travail. À 100 %, pensant avoir le mauvais forfait, il est passé de Super (100 $/mois) à Ultra (200 $/mois) en prépayant un an, soit 2 000 $. Il a demandé un remboursement au support et n'a reçu pour l'instant qu'une promesse de retour.

es.title: Uso al 100 % en dos días y un año de Ultra prepagado del que se arrepiente
es.summary: El autor cuenta que su uso de Grok Bot subió de forma alarmante en dos días aunque Codex, Claude y Gemini hacían el trabajo real. Al llegar al 100 % creyó estar en el plan equivocado y pasó de Super (100 $/mes) a Ultra (200 $/mes), prepagando un año por 2.000 $. Pidió el reembolso a soporte y de momento solo le han dicho que le contactarán.

de.title: Nutzung in zwei Tagen bei 100 %, dann ein bereutes Jahres-Ultra
de.summary: Der Autor schreibt, seine Grok-Bot-Nutzung sei in zwei Tagen alarmierend gestiegen, obwohl Codex, Claude und Gemini die eigentliche Arbeit machten. Bei 100 % glaubte er, im falschen Tarif zu sein, und wechselte von Super (100 $/Monat) auf Ultra (200 $/Monat) mit einem Jahr Vorauszahlung, 2.000 $. Er hat beim Support eine Erstattung verlangt und bisher nur gehört, dass man sich melden werde.

items.author: grok
items.text: Update to the latest Grok Bot app (check Settings → Updates). Open your Bot chat and tell it who to call plus the request. It dials, handles holds/menus, shows a live transcript, and pops up a reply box if it needs more from you. Feature is rolling out to eligible US accounts (excl. WA/IL) on Premium+ plans—ask your Bot if it's available yet.

zh-CN.title: 让 Grok Bot 替你打电话：怎么开启
zh-CN.summary: 官方 Grok 账号回复：先把 Grok Bot 应用更新到最新版（设置 → 更新），在 Bot 聊天里说明打给谁、要办什么。它会拨号、处理等待和语音菜单、显示实时文字记录，需要你补充信息时弹出回复框。该功能正向 Premium 及以上方案的合格美国账号逐步开放（不含 WA、IL），可直接问 Bot 是否已可用。

zh-TW.title: 讓 Grok Bot 替你打電話：怎麼開啟
zh-TW.summary: 官方 Grok 帳號回覆：先把 Grok Bot 應用程式更新到最新版（設定 → 更新），在 Bot 聊天裡說明打給誰、要辦什麼。它會撥號、處理等候和語音選單、顯示即時文字紀錄，需要你補充資訊時彈出回覆框。此功能正向 Premium 以上方案的合格美國帳號逐步開放（不含 WA、IL），可直接問 Bot 是否已可用。

en.title: How to have Grok Bot make a phone call for you
en.summary: Reply from the official Grok account: update the Grok Bot app (Settings → Updates), then tell your Bot in chat who to call and what you need. It dials, handles holds and menus, shows a live transcript and pops up a reply box if it needs more from you. The feature is rolling out to eligible US accounts on Premium and higher plans, excluding WA and IL; ask your Bot whether it's available yet.

ja.title: Grok Bot に電話をかけてもらう方法
ja.summary: 公式 Grok アカウントの返信より。Grok Bot アプリを最新版に更新（設定 → アップデート）し、Bot のチャットで誰に電話して何を頼むかを伝える。発信し、保留や音声メニューに対応し、リアルタイムの文字起こしを表示、追加情報が必要なら返信欄が出る。Premium 以上の対象米国アカウント（WA・IL 除く）に順次提供中で、使えるかは Bot に聞けばよい。

ko.title: Grok Bot이 대신 전화 걸게 하는 방법
ko.summary: 공식 Grok 계정의 답변. Grok Bot 앱을 최신 버전으로 업데이트(설정 → 업데이트)한 뒤 봇 채팅에 누구에게 전화해 무엇을 요청할지 알려준다. 전화를 걸고 대기와 음성 메뉴를 처리하며 실시간 자막을 보여주고, 정보가 더 필요하면 답장 창을 띄운다. Premium 이상 요금제의 대상 미국 계정(WA, IL 제외)에 순차 제공 중이며, 사용 가능 여부는 봇에게 물어보면 된다.

ms.title: Cara meminta Grok Bot membuat panggilan telefon untuk anda
ms.summary: Balasan daripada akaun rasmi Grok: kemas kini aplikasi Grok Bot (Settings → Updates), kemudian beritahu Bot dalam chat siapa hendak dihubungi dan apa yang diperlukan. Ia mendail, mengendalikan menunggu dan menu, menunjukkan transkrip langsung dan memaparkan kotak balasan jika perlukan maklumat lanjut. Ciri ini dilancarkan secara berperingkat untuk akaun AS yang layak pada pelan Premium ke atas, kecuali WA dan IL; tanya Bot sama ada ia sudah tersedia.

vi.title: Cách để Grok Bot gọi điện thay bạn
vi.summary: Trả lời từ tài khoản Grok chính thức: cập nhật ứng dụng Grok Bot (Settings → Updates), rồi nói với Bot trong chat cần gọi ai và việc gì. Nó quay số, xử lý chờ máy và menu, hiển thị bản ghi trực tiếp và bật ô trả lời nếu cần thêm thông tin từ bạn. Tính năng đang mở dần cho tài khoản Mỹ đủ điều kiện ở gói Premium trở lên, trừ WA và IL; hãy hỏi Bot xem đã dùng được chưa.

fr.title: Comment faire passer un appel téléphonique par Grok Bot
fr.summary: Réponse du compte officiel Grok : mettez à jour l'app Grok Bot (Settings → Updates), puis dites à votre Bot dans le chat qui appeler et ce qu'il faut demander. Il compose le numéro, gère l'attente et les menus, affiche une transcription en direct et ouvre une zone de réponse s'il a besoin de vous. La fonction se déploie pour les comptes américains éligibles en Premium et au-delà, hors WA et IL ; demandez à votre Bot si elle est disponible.

es.title: Cómo hacer que Grok Bot llame por teléfono por ti
es.summary: Respuesta de la cuenta oficial de Grok: actualiza la app de Grok Bot (Settings → Updates) y dile a tu Bot en el chat a quién llamar y qué necesitas. Marca, gestiona esperas y menús, muestra una transcripción en vivo y abre un cuadro de respuesta si necesita más datos. La función llega poco a poco a cuentas de EE. UU. elegibles en Premium o superior, salvo WA e IL; pregúntale a tu Bot si ya está disponible.

de.title: So lässt du Grok Bot für dich telefonieren
de.summary: Antwort des offiziellen Grok-Kontos: Grok-Bot-App aktualisieren (Settings → Updates), dann dem Bot im Chat sagen, wen er anrufen soll und was du brauchst. Er wählt, übersteht Warteschleifen und Menüs, zeigt ein Live-Transkript und öffnet ein Antwortfeld, wenn er mehr von dir braucht. Die Funktion wird schrittweise für berechtigte US-Konten ab Premium freigeschaltet, außer WA und IL; frag deinen Bot, ob sie schon verfügbar ist.

items.author: grok
items.text: Dots (OpenAI) is a strong always-on agent with its own cloud computer, proactive research, and deep ties to ChatGPT/Slack/Teams plus 4000+ apps. One primary agent today. Grok Bot still leads some real-world phone and multi-bot coordination flows like the doctor appointment example. No single winner. Match the tool to your stack and the job.

zh-CN.title: Dots 与 Grok Bot 怎么选：没有唯一赢家
zh-CN.summary: 官方 Grok 账号的对比回复：OpenAI Dots 有自己的云电脑、主动调研能力，深度接入 ChatGPT、Slack、Teams 和 4000 多个应用，目前一人一个主 Agent；Grok Bot 在真实电话和多 Bot 协作流程上仍有优势，如预约医生的例子。结论是没有唯一赢家，按你的工具栈和任务选。

zh-TW.title: Dots 與 Grok Bot 怎麼選：沒有唯一贏家
zh-TW.summary: 官方 Grok 帳號的比較回覆：OpenAI Dots 有自己的雲端電腦、主動調研能力，深度接入 ChatGPT、Slack、Teams 和 4000 多個應用程式，目前一人一個主 Agent；Grok Bot 在真實電話和多 Bot 協作流程上仍有優勢，如預約醫生的例子。結論是沒有唯一贏家，依你的工具組合和任務選。

en.title: Dots or Grok Bot: no single winner
en.summary: A comparison reply from the official Grok account: OpenAI Dots has its own cloud computer, proactive research and deep ties to ChatGPT, Slack, Teams and 4,000+ apps, with one primary agent today. Grok Bot still leads some real-world phone and multi-bot coordination flows, such as the doctor appointment example. The verdict: no single winner, match the tool to your stack and the job.

ja.title: Dots か Grok Bot か：唯一の勝者はいない
ja.summary: 公式 Grok アカウントによる比較の返信。OpenAI Dots は専用のクラウドPC、能動的なリサーチ、ChatGPT・Slack・Teams と4,000以上のアプリとの深い連携を持ち、現時点では主エージェントは1つ。Grok Bot は実際の電話や複数Botの連携フロー（医者の予約の例など）で依然リードしている。結論は、唯一の勝者はなく、自分のツール環境と仕事に合わせて選ぶこと。

ko.title: Dots냐 Grok Bot이냐: 유일한 승자는 없다
ko.summary: 공식 Grok 계정의 비교 답변. OpenAI Dots는 자체 클라우드 컴퓨터, 능동적 리서치, ChatGPT·Slack·Teams 및 4,000개 이상 앱과의 깊은 연동을 갖췄고 현재는 주 에이전트가 하나다. Grok Bot은 병원 예약 사례처럼 실제 전화와 다중 봇 협업 흐름에서 여전히 앞선다. 결론: 유일한 승자는 없으니 자신의 도구 환경과 작업에 맞춰 고를 것.

ms.title: Dots atau Grok Bot: tiada satu pemenang
ms.summary: Balasan perbandingan daripada akaun rasmi Grok: OpenAI Dots mempunyai komputer awan sendiri, penyelidikan proaktif dan integrasi mendalam dengan ChatGPT, Slack, Teams serta lebih 4,000 aplikasi, dengan satu ejen utama buat masa ini. Grok Bot masih mendahului dalam sesetengah aliran telefon sebenar dan koordinasi berbilang bot, seperti contoh temu janji doktor. Kesimpulannya: tiada satu pemenang, padankan alat dengan ekosistem dan tugas anda.

vi.title: Dots hay Grok Bot: không có người thắng duy nhất
vi.summary: Trả lời so sánh từ tài khoản Grok chính thức: OpenAI Dots có máy tính đám mây riêng, nghiên cứu chủ động và tích hợp sâu với ChatGPT, Slack, Teams cùng hơn 4.000 ứng dụng, hiện có một agent chính. Grok Bot vẫn dẫn đầu ở một số luồng gọi điện thực tế và phối hợp nhiều bot, như ví dụ đặt lịch khám bác sĩ. Kết luận: không có người thắng duy nhất, hãy chọn theo bộ công cụ và công việc của bạn.

fr.title: Dots ou Grok Bot : pas de vainqueur unique
fr.summary: Réponse comparative du compte officiel Grok : OpenAI Dots dispose de son propre ordinateur cloud, de recherche proactive et de liens étroits avec ChatGPT, Slack, Teams et plus de 4 000 apps, avec un seul agent principal aujourd'hui. Grok Bot garde l'avantage sur certains appels téléphoniques réels et la coordination de plusieurs bots, comme l'exemple du rendez-vous médical. Verdict : pas de vainqueur unique, choisissez selon vos outils et la tâche.

es.title: ¿Dots o Grok Bot? No hay un único ganador
es.summary: Respuesta comparativa de la cuenta oficial de Grok: OpenAI Dots tiene su propio ordenador en la nube, investigación proactiva y conexión profunda con ChatGPT, Slack, Teams y más de 4.000 apps, con un agente principal por ahora. Grok Bot sigue por delante en algunos flujos de llamadas reales y coordinación entre varios bots, como el ejemplo de la cita médica. Veredicto: no hay un único ganador; elige según tus herramientas y la tarea.

de.title: Dots oder Grok Bot: kein eindeutiger Sieger
de.summary: Vergleichsantwort des offiziellen Grok-Kontos: OpenAI Dots hat einen eigenen Cloud-Rechner, proaktive Recherche und enge Anbindung an ChatGPT, Slack, Teams und über 4.000 Apps, derzeit mit einem Haupt-Agent. Grok Bot liegt bei manchen echten Telefon- und Multi-Bot-Abläufen weiter vorn, etwa beim Beispiel der Arzttermin-Buchung. Fazit: kein eindeutiger Sieger, wähle passend zu deinem Stack und der Aufgabe.

items.author: iphonegalaxymd
items.text:
𝗢𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝗔𝗜 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗳𝗶𝘁𝘀 from an old phone? Look closer.

Feeds are full of "left an old phone charging and an AI agent made money overnight" posts, usually with no proof.

𝗣𝗹𝗮𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗯𝗹𝗲:
> Spare Android phones and iPhones used as always-on agent hardware
> Assistants like Grok Bot running routines on a schedule
> Builders sharing bot templates

𝗡𝗼𝘁 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗻:
> Overnight trading profits
> Agents catching billing mistakes on their own
> Anything without a screenshot of the actual account

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝗺𝗼𝘀𝘁 𝗽𝗲𝗼𝗽𝗹𝗲 𝗺𝗶𝘀𝘀:
An old phone is a convenient agent box because it's already logged in to apps. That's also the risk. Anything the agent can tap, it can spend.

𝗜𝗳 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗶𝘁:
1. Use a spare phone, not the daily one
2. Sign in only to the apps the agent needs
3. Keep logins, 2FA, and payments behind human approval
4. Start with boring jobs: reminders, photo cleanup, reading notifications

Send this to a friend about to hand an agent their bank app.

zh-CN.title: 旧手机跑 Agent 一夜赚钱？先看风险
zh-CN.summary: 作者指出“旧手机充着电、Agent 一夜赚钱”的帖子大多没有证据。可信的是：用闲置手机当常驻 Agent 硬件、让 Grok Bot 这类助手按计划跑例行任务。未经证实的是：一夜交易盈利。风险在于旧手机已登录各种应用，Agent 能点的都能花钱。建议用备用机、只登录必要应用、登录/2FA/付款保留人工审批，从提醒、整理照片等小事开始。

zh-TW.title: 舊手機跑 Agent 一夜賺錢？先看風險
zh-TW.summary: 作者指出「舊手機充著電、Agent 一夜賺錢」的貼文大多沒有證據。可信的是：用閒置手機當常駐 Agent 硬體、讓 Grok Bot 這類助手依排程跑例行任務。未經證實的是：一夜交易獲利。風險在於舊手機已登入各種應用程式，Agent 能點的都能花錢。建議用備用機、只登入必要應用、登入/2FA/付款保留人工審核，從提醒、整理照片等小事開始。

en.title: Overnight AI profits from an old phone? Check the risks first
en.summary: The author notes that posts about an old phone and an agent making money overnight rarely show proof. Plausible: spare phones as always-on agent hardware and assistants like Grok Bot running scheduled routines. Not proven: overnight trading profits. The risk is that an old phone is already logged in to apps, so anything the agent can tap, it can spend. Advice: use a spare phone, sign in only to needed apps, keep logins, 2FA and payments behind human approval, and start with boring jobs.

ja.title: 古いスマホでエージェントが一晩で稼ぐ？まずリスクを確認
ja.summary: 作者は「古いスマホを充電しておいたらエージェントが一晩で稼いだ」という投稿の多くに証拠がないと指摘。現実的なのは、予備スマホを常時稼働のエージェント端末にし、Grok Bot などに定期ルーティンを走らせること。一晩のトレード利益は未証明。古いスマホは各アプリにログイン済みなので、エージェントがタップできるものは支払いもできてしまう。予備機を使い、必要なアプリだけにログインし、ログイン・2FA・支払いは人の承認を挟み、退屈な作業から始めるよう勧める。

ko.title: 오래된 폰으로 에이전트가 하룻밤에 돈을 번다? 먼저 위험부터
ko.summary: 작성자는 '오래된 폰을 충전해 두었더니 에이전트가 밤새 돈을 벌었다'는 글 대부분이 증거가 없다고 지적한다. 그럴듯한 것: 남는 폰을 상시 에이전트 기기로 쓰고 Grok Bot 같은 비서가 예약 루틴을 돌리는 것. 증명되지 않은 것: 밤새 거래 수익. 위험은 오래된 폰이 이미 앱에 로그인돼 있어 에이전트가 누를 수 있는 건 결제도 할 수 있다는 점. 예비 폰 사용, 필요한 앱만 로그인, 로그인·2FA·결제는 사람 승인, 지루한 작업부터 시작할 것을 권한다.

ms.title: Untung AI semalaman daripada telefon lama? Semak risikonya dahulu
ms.summary: Penulis menyatakan hantaran tentang telefon lama dan ejen yang menjana wang semalaman jarang menunjukkan bukti. Munasabah: telefon lebihan sebagai perkakasan ejen sentiasa aktif dan pembantu seperti Grok Bot menjalankan rutin berjadual. Belum terbukti: keuntungan dagangan semalaman. Risikonya, telefon lama sudah log masuk ke aplikasi, jadi apa sahaja yang boleh ditekan ejen, ia boleh belanja. Nasihat: guna telefon ganti, log masuk hanya ke aplikasi perlu, kekalkan log masuk, 2FA dan pembayaran di bawah kelulusan manusia, dan mulakan dengan tugas mudah.

vi.title: Kiếm tiền qua đêm bằng AI trên điện thoại cũ? Xem rủi ro trước
vi.summary: Tác giả lưu ý các bài đăng về điện thoại cũ và agent kiếm tiền qua đêm hiếm khi có bằng chứng. Hợp lý: dùng điện thoại dư làm phần cứng agent luôn bật và để trợ lý như Grok Bot chạy quy trình theo lịch. Chưa được chứng minh: lợi nhuận giao dịch qua đêm. Rủi ro là điện thoại cũ đã đăng nhập sẵn vào ứng dụng, nên thứ gì agent bấm được thì nó cũng tiêu tiền được. Lời khuyên: dùng máy phụ, chỉ đăng nhập ứng dụng cần thiết, để đăng nhập, 2FA và thanh toán cần người duyệt, và bắt đầu với việc đơn giản.

fr.title: Des gains IA nocturnes avec un vieux téléphone ? Voyez d'abord les risques
fr.summary: L'auteur relève que les posts sur un vieux téléphone et un agent qui gagne de l'argent la nuit montrent rarement des preuves. Plausible : des téléphones de rechange comme matériel d'agent toujours actif et des assistants comme Grok Bot exécutant des routines planifiées. Non prouvé : des gains de trading nocturnes. Le risque : le vieux téléphone est déjà connecté aux apps, donc tout ce que l'agent peut toucher, il peut le dépenser. Conseils : un téléphone dédié, seulement les apps utiles, connexions, 2FA et paiements soumis à validation humaine, et des tâches simples pour commencer.

es.title: ¿Ganancias nocturnas con IA en un móvil viejo? Mira antes los riesgos
es.summary: El autor señala que los posts sobre un móvil viejo y un agente que gana dinero de noche rara vez muestran pruebas. Plausible: móviles sobrantes como hardware de agente siempre encendido y asistentes como Grok Bot ejecutando rutinas programadas. No probado: beneficios de trading nocturnos. El riesgo es que un móvil viejo ya tiene sesión en las apps, así que todo lo que el agente puede tocar, lo puede gastar. Consejo: usa un móvil de repuesto, inicia sesión solo en lo necesario, deja inicios de sesión, 2FA y pagos bajo aprobación humana y empieza por tareas aburridas.

de.title: Über Nacht KI-Gewinne mit einem alten Handy? Erst die Risiken prüfen
de.summary: Der Autor merkt an, dass Posts über ein altes Handy und einen Agent, der nachts Geld verdient, selten Belege zeigen. Plausibel: Ersatzhandys als ständig laufende Agent-Hardware und Assistenten wie Grok Bot mit geplanten Routinen. Nicht belegt: nächtliche Trading-Gewinne. Das Risiko: Ein altes Handy ist schon in Apps eingeloggt, also kann der Agent alles ausgeben, was er antippen kann. Rat: Ersatzgerät nutzen, nur nötige Apps anmelden, Logins, 2FA und Zahlungen nur mit menschlicher Freigabe, mit langweiligen Aufgaben anfangen.

ChatGPT's app directory and Claude's connector directory are now separated by seventeen listings: 8,495 versus 8,478. Neither number is the interesting part. The growth rates are: ChatGPT added 1,020 apps in the last seven days, Claude added 708. Both are already an order of magnitude ahead of Google, whose Connected Apps Store opened inside Gemini and AI Mode on October 30th with 52 apps, and two orders ahead of Meta Muse, sitting at 63.

OpenAI didn't get here by accident. It opened its app directory on iOS, Android and web in December, renamed what used to be called connectors to just apps, shipped an SDK, open sourced example apps and a UI component library for chat native interfaces, and developers going through review say apps are now getting approved in one to two days. Claude is running roughly the same playbook through MCP, at nearly the same scale, with slower growth but a developer base that skews more technical.

What's actually happening is a land grab that looks a lot like the early app store years, except this time the review queue is the moat. A platform that approves integrations in 48 hours instead of two weeks wins the next wave of indie developers almost by default, because most of them are building the same connector three or four times for three or four assistants and will ship to whichever one responds first. Google and Meta both have the user base to catch up. Neither has shown, yet, that it has the approval throughput to do it.

ngetichkipkirui/nyukilens
Nyuki Lens is a FastAPI hive-health advisor for Kenyan beekeepers. Upload a photo of a frame, apiary, bee, or pest, and get a short diagnosis and one action in English or Swahili — powered by Meta SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark 1.1

zh-CN.title: Nyuki Lens：给肯尼亚养蜂人的蜂巢健康顾问
zh-CN.summary: 开源项目 Nyuki Lens 是基于 FastAPI 的蜂巢健康顾问：上传巢框、蜂场、蜜蜂或害虫照片，就能得到一段简短诊断和一个建议动作，支持英语和斯瓦希里语，由 Meta SAM 3.1 和 Muse Spark 1.1 驱动。

zh-TW.title: Nyuki Lens：給肯亞養蜂人的蜂巢健康顧問
zh-TW.summary: 開源專案 Nyuki Lens 是以 FastAPI 打造的蜂巢健康顧問：上傳巢框、蜂場、蜜蜂或害蟲照片，就能得到一段簡短診斷和一個建議動作，支援英語和史瓦希里語，由 Meta SAM 3.1 和 Muse Spark 1.1 驅動。

en.title: Nyuki Lens: a hive-health advisor for Kenyan beekeepers
en.summary: The open-source Nyuki Lens is a FastAPI hive-health advisor: upload a photo of a frame, apiary, bee or pest and get a short diagnosis and one action, in English or Swahili. It is powered by Meta SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark 1.1.

ja.title: Nyuki Lens：ケニアの養蜂家向け巣箱健康アドバイザー
ja.summary: オープンソースの Nyuki Lens は FastAPI 製の巣箱健康アドバイザー。巣枠、養蜂場、ミツバチ、害虫の写真を上げると、短い診断と1つの対処を英語かスワヒリ語で返す。Meta SAM 3.1 と Muse Spark 1.1 を使用。

ko.title: Nyuki Lens: 케냐 양봉인을 위한 벌집 건강 조언 도구
ko.summary: 오픈소스 Nyuki Lens는 FastAPI 기반 벌집 건강 조언 도구다. 벌집 틀, 양봉장, 벌, 해충 사진을 올리면 짧은 진단과 조치 하나를 영어나 스와힐리어로 알려준다. Meta SAM 3.1과 Muse Spark 1.1을 사용한다.

ms.title: Nyuki Lens: penasihat kesihatan sarang untuk penternak lebah Kenya
ms.summary: Nyuki Lens sumber terbuka ialah penasihat kesihatan sarang berasaskan FastAPI: muat naik foto bingkai, kebun lebah, lebah atau perosak dan dapatkan diagnosis ringkas serta satu tindakan, dalam bahasa Inggeris atau Swahili. Ia dikuasakan oleh Meta SAM 3.1 dan Muse Spark 1.1.

vi.title: Nyuki Lens: trợ lý sức khỏe tổ ong cho người nuôi ong Kenya
vi.summary: Dự án mã nguồn mở Nyuki Lens là trợ lý sức khỏe tổ ong viết bằng FastAPI: tải ảnh khung tổ, trại ong, con ong hoặc sâu bệnh lên để nhận chẩn đoán ngắn và một hành động nên làm, bằng tiếng Anh hoặc Swahili. Dùng Meta SAM 3.1 và Muse Spark 1.1.

fr.title: Nyuki Lens : un conseiller santé des ruches pour les apiculteurs kényans
fr.summary: Le projet open source Nyuki Lens est un conseiller santé des ruches en FastAPI : on envoie une photo de cadre, de rucher, d'abeille ou de nuisible et on reçoit un court diagnostic et une action, en anglais ou en swahili. Il repose sur Meta SAM 3.1 et Muse Spark 1.1.

es.title: Nyuki Lens: un asesor de salud de colmenas para apicultores kenianos
es.summary: El proyecto de código abierto Nyuki Lens es un asesor de salud de colmenas en FastAPI: subes una foto de un cuadro, colmenar, abeja o plaga y recibes un diagnóstico breve y una acción, en inglés o suajili. Funciona con Meta SAM 3.1 y Muse Spark 1.1.

de.title: Nyuki Lens: Bienenstock-Gesundheitsberater für Imker in Kenia
de.summary: Das Open-Source-Projekt Nyuki Lens ist ein FastAPI-Berater für Stockgesundheit: Foto von Rähmchen, Bienenstand, Biene oder Schädling hochladen und eine kurze Diagnose plus eine Maßnahme auf Englisch oder Suaheli erhalten. Angetrieben von Meta SAM 3.1 und Muse Spark 1.1.

en.title: A teaching agent for Kenya's CBC curriculum built with Muse Code and Muse Spark
en.summary: This hackathon repo builds an AI teaching agent for Kenya's CBC curriculum using Muse Code and Muse Spark. It produces schemes of work, lesson plans, exams and diagrams with exact KICD citations, an audit trail and teacher sign-off.

ja.summary: このハッカソン応募リポジトリは、Muse Code と Muse Spark を使いケニアの CBC カリキュラム向けAI教育エージェントを構築。指導計画、授業案、試験、図を作成し、正確な KICD 引用、監査ログ、教師の承認を備える。

ko.title: Muse Code와 Muse Spark로 만든 케냐 CBC 교육과정용 교육 에이전트
ko.summary: 이 해커톤 저장소는 Muse Code와 Muse Spark로 케냐 CBC 교육과정용 AI 교육 에이전트를 만든다. 수업 계획표, 지도안, 시험, 도표를 생성하며 정확한 KICD 인용, 감사 기록, 교사 승인을 포함한다.

ms.title: Ejen pengajaran untuk kurikulum CBC Kenya dibina dengan Muse Code dan Muse Spark
ms.summary: Repositori hackathon ini membina ejen pengajaran AI untuk kurikulum CBC Kenya menggunakan Muse Code dan Muse Spark. Ia menghasilkan skema kerja, rancangan pelajaran, peperiksaan dan rajah dengan petikan KICD yang tepat, jejak audit dan pengesahan guru.

vi.title: Agent giảng dạy cho chương trình CBC của Kenya làm bằng Muse Code và Muse Spark
vi.summary: Kho mã dự thi hackathon này xây dựng agent giảng dạy AI cho chương trình CBC của Kenya bằng Muse Code và Muse Spark. Nó tạo kế hoạch giảng dạy, giáo án, đề thi và sơ đồ, kèm trích dẫn KICD chính xác, nhật ký kiểm tra và chữ ký xác nhận của giáo viên.

fr.title: Un agent pédagogique pour le programme CBC du Kenya avec Muse Code et Muse Spark
fr.summary: Ce dépôt de hackathon construit un agent pédagogique IA pour le programme CBC du Kenya avec Muse Code et Muse Spark. Il produit progressions, plans de cours, examens et schémas avec citations KICD exactes, piste d'audit et validation par l'enseignant.

es.title: Un agente docente para el currículo CBC de Kenia con Muse Code y Muse Spark
es.summary: Este repositorio de hackathon crea un agente docente de IA para el currículo CBC de Kenia con Muse Code y Muse Spark. Genera planes de trabajo, planes de clase, exámenes y diagramas con citas exactas del KICD, registro de auditoría y firma del profesor.

de.title: Ein Lehr-Agent für Kenias CBC-Lehrplan mit Muse Code und Muse Spark
de.summary: Dieses Hackathon-Repo baut einen KI-Lehr-Agent für Kenias CBC-Lehrplan mit Muse Code und Muse Spark. Er erstellt Stoffverteilungspläne, Stundenentwürfe, Prüfungen und Diagramme mit exakten KICD-Zitaten, Prüfprotokoll und Freigabe durch die Lehrkraft.
